svg.title: FDAI Azure deployment topology
svg.desc: Azure platform signals and scheduled probes enter Azure Event Hubs through its Kafka endpoint. A VNet-integrated Container Apps environment runs the FDAI core, scheduled jobs, and a separately identified Operator API. The core uses managed identity to read Azure Resource Graph, request optional Azure OpenAI models, obtain Key Vault references, and write governed state and append-only audit evidence to PostgreSQL. Private endpoints and private DNS keep supported data-plane traffic inside the virtual network. Operators authenticate with Microsoft Entra ID, inspect the read-only console, approve high-risk work through Teams, and receive governed changes through Git pull requests. Application Insights and Log Analytics observe every runtime path without becoming a decision surface.
svg.text: A private, identity-separated Azure deployment for the FDAI control plane, operator console, governed data services, and delivery channels.

Operator and delivery channels

Container Apps infrastructure subnet

Azure platform signals. Resource changes, health, metrics, and cost signals
Scheduled probes. Inventory, resilience, forecast, and cost checks
Operators. Reader, contributor, approver, owner, and break-glass roles
Azure Event Hubs. Kafka :9093 topics, control topics, and dead-letter streams
Azure Container Registry. Signed images pinned by digest
User-assigned managed identities. Separate executor, inventory, read, command, and job principals
FDAI core Container App. Fifteen agents, trust router, risk gate, and privileged executor
Container Apps Jobs. Inventory, detection, canary, measurement, and resilience jobs
Operator API Container App. Entra JWT, App Roles, read identity, and command transport identity
Private endpoints and DNS. Event Hubs, Key Vault, registry, storage, and model data planes
Azure Database for PostgreSQL. State, append-only audit, operator memory, and pgvector
Azure Key Vault. Native Container Apps secret references
Azure OpenAI. Optional governed T2 model capabilities
Application Insights and Log Analytics. Traces, metrics, logs, alerts, and correlation
Microsoft Entra ID. Browser authentication and App Roles
Read-only operator console. Evidence, incidents, approvals, and runtime projections
Teams approval channel. Human approval with separate approver identity
Git remediation pull request. Reviewable, reversible change delivery
